crossRefs.note: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.
crossRefs.keyword: victory. Heb. salvation, or, deliverance. turned

crossRefs.note: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
crossRefs.keyword: victory. Heb. salvation, or, deliverance. turned

translations.web: The victory that day was turned into mourning among all the people; for the people heard it said that day, “The king grieves for his son.”
translations.bsb: And that day’s victory was turned into mourning for all the people, because on that day they were told, “The king is grieving over his son.”
translations.kjv: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people: for the people heard say that day how the king was grieved for his son.
translations.asv: And the victory that day was turned into mourning unto all the people; for the people heard say that day, The king grieveth for his son.
